title: Rosie's Bakery landing page
summary: One-page site with menu, working contact form, mobile layout, fast load, matching the mockup.

criteria.description: The landing page loads with HTTP 200 and no JavaScript errors.
criteria.rationale: A broken page can't be used by customers.

criteria.description: The menu lists the bakery's items, including 'Croissant'.
criteria.rationale: The client asked for a menu.

criteria.description: The contact form can be filled in and submitted, and shows a confirmation.
criteria.rationale: Customers must be able to contact the bakery.

criteria.description: No horizontal scrolling on phones (375px) or desktops (1440px).
criteria.rationale: The client asked for it to work on mobile.

criteria.description: The page loads in under 3 seconds and weighs under 2000 KB.
criteria.rationale: The client asked for it to load fast.

criteria.description: The page layout matches the agreed mockup (hero, menu, contact form, footer).
The client receives contact form submissions by email.
criteria.rationale: Email delivery can't be observed from the website.
